basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player from Atlanta, Georgia, always looking to expand my friend list for those sweet XP gains! I'm a graduate student at Georgia Tech, pursuing a degree in Computer Science. When I'm not catching Pokémon, I'm either watching General Hospital or diving into random stories on StoryTime. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes, around 8 PM to midnight. Single and loving the free time to explore my hobbies!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently a Computer Science student at Georgia Tech, gaining knowledge through coursework and self-study. My expertise is more on the technical side, but I'm learning about social interactions through gaming communities like Pokémon Go.
